newsitem.title: UK: British Aerospace up on Airbus float hopes.
newsitem.headline: British Aerospace up on Airbus float hopes.

text.p: Shares in British aircraft maker British Aerospace Plc were up 9-1/2p at 12.18-1/2 by 1000 GMT on hopes that Airbus Industrie, in which BAe has a stake, will become a stock company by the year 1999, market makers said.

Gustav Humbert, a senior official at Daimler-Benz Aerospace Airbus (Dasa), one of BAe's partners in Airbus, told a German newspaper over the weekend that the move to a stock-holding company is planned to occur before 1999.
"If Airbus is reorganised in this way, the company should become a more attractive proposition," one market maker said.
Under the plan, Airbus would be turned into a stock company under French law, Humbert said.
Airbus's partners include France's Aerospatiale, BAe, Dasa, and Spain's Construcciones Aeronauticas.
